scraperConfig.analyzerNotes: Skyguide job board using a custom platform. Job listings are displayed in a table structure with class 'data-row' for each job. The pagination shows "Results 1 – 4 of 4" indicating all results are on a single page with no pagination mechanism. Each job card contains title with link, location, department (not company - this is a single employer site for Skyguide), and posting date. No salary information or description snippets are visible in the listing view. The site appears to be server-side rendered and does not require JavaScript for basic content display.
